intel.title: [CISA KEV] Google Pixel - Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-58704
廠商: Google
產品: Pixel
漏洞名稱: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
說明: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-19
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 新增 Google Pixel 行動裝置蜂巢式數據機的授權不當漏洞（CVE-2026-58704）。該漏洞源於邏輯錯誤，允許攻擊者繞過權限檢查並提升權限，且已有活躍的利用活動。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Cisco Identity Services Engine - Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-76460
廠商: Cisco
產品: Identity Services Engine
漏洞名稱: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
說明: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-19
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) 存在權限 API 使用不當漏洞（CVE-2026-76460），允許未經授權的遠端攻擊者繞過網頁管理介面並取得設備控制權。此漏洞已被收錄於 CISA KEV 之中，顯示已有在野利用之活躍攻擊。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Acronis Backup - Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-87886
廠商: Acronis
產品: Backup
漏洞名稱: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
說明: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-19
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 新增收錄 Acronis Backup 針對 cPanel/WHM 插件及 Plesk 擴充套件的預設權限不當漏洞（CVE-2026-87886）。此漏洞已被發現在野利用，攻擊者可藉此進行權限提升。由於公司內部有使用 Acronis Cyber Backup，需防範此風險。
analysis.recommendation: 1. 盤點並確認公司使用的 Acronis Cyber Backup 12.5 與 15 是否有啟用 cPanel & WHM 插件或 Plesk 擴充套件。2. 若有啟用，請立即參考 Acronis 官方安全公告（SEC-10986）升級至安全版本或套用官方修補程式。3. 限制備份管理介面的網路存取，僅允許特定信任的 IP 進行連線。
